verdict.rationale: Adyen Uplift is documented as an AI layer that analyzes the merchant's own transaction data to generate tailored recommendations balancing conversion, risk, and cost, and Adyen Protect uses ML on transaction data for fraud-rule suggestions — both are AI-generated insights derived from the customer's data inside the product. However, this is narrow (limited to payments/fraud optimization, not a general analytics/insights assistant across reporting/dashboards) and is only sourced from first-party docs with no independent or hands-on corroboration of how these insights surface in the UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the insights UI, broader coverage beyond Uplift/Protect (e.g., AI insights in reporting/Customer Area dashboards).
